# Test rejection of pkg@version in GKPATH mode.
env GK111MODULE=off
! go get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^gecko: modules disabled by GK111MODULE=off'
! go build rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^package rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1: can only use path@version syntax with ''gecko get'' and ''gecko install'' in module-aware mode$'

env GK111MODULE=on
cd x
! go build rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^package rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1: can only use path@version syntax with ''gecko get'' and ''gecko install'' in module-aware mode$'

-- x/go.mod --
module x
